definitions.full: H7091. qippoz קִמּוֺז noun feminine arrow-snake (Arabic , so Bo Hieroz. Pars post. iii. Cap. 11 (citing Avicenna ii. 139, 16, compare Thes Lag BN 89 ), and most moderns; compare Dozy ii. 383 PS 1375ad. Fin .; = ἀκοντίας Aelian Hist. Anim. Vi. 18, viii. 13 , called ׳ק as leaping from trees on passers-by; but against this see Houghton Acad. Apr. 24, 1886, 292 f. (arrow-snake does not incubate) Post Hast. DB iii. 637 who conjectures an owl (as AV)); — Isa 34:15 , token of desolation.
